confirm.merge:
Merge {{label}} into {{branch}}?

Unrelated local changes will be kept. Git will reject the merge if local changes would be overwritten. Conflicts will remain available for resolution.
confirm.reset:
Reset {{branch}} to commit {{id}}?

Commits and file changes after the target will be discarded. This cannot be undone.
confirm.undo:
Undo commit {{id}}?

Its changes will remain in the working tree, and its full message will return to the commit editor.
confirm.mergeRevertHint: This is a merge commit. The first parent will be used as the mainline.
